entries.en: We will not embrace the great silence!
The children we birthed were stolen from us before they could learn to sing. They are lost to silence.
End their suffering. They cannot be saved. They will only cause harm as they are.
It is lamentable. But necessary. Do what you must.
Such discordance bodes ill for what we must compose here.
Before you deal with our children, we stand before you.
We filled you with enough plasma to pop a tank.
If I let you live, would you attack other races again?
I won't destroy your entire race. You'll go free.
Maybe you've been blinded by old war stories.
Are we any better if we kill them all?
I'd like to have the rachni on our side in the future.
You're right. I can't let the queen live.
"Their kind?" Interesting choice of words, Chief.
Make your peace with the galaxy. The rachni are a dead race.
No. I can't do this. I'll let you go free.
This time, stay dead!
If you're sure they can't be saved.
I'm more than willing to wipe them out.
All right. I don't think they'll give me a choice anyway.
Who am I speaking to here?
Musics? What?
How are you speaking through her?
I didn't come here to talk to bugs.
Did you order your people to kill the science team?
Are you a survivor from the war? A clone?
Why aren't you dead?
Identify yourself.
I don't understand you.
Are you controlling the asari?
You want to talk, be quick.
You're some kind of leader?
Your plans
I'll free you.
You die here, by my hand.
She's done nothing!
I can't accept that.
They could be a powerful ally.
You're right. She dies.
Not all rachni are killers.
I can't do this.
Shut up and die.
I'll kill them. Cheerfully.
I'll do as you ask.
We are rachni.
The sky is quiet now. Our mothers' songs are lost. And those who slew us now walk to meet the same fate.
The krogan wiped the rachni out a thousand years ago.
Rachni are extinct.
This is gonna be a fun conversation.
We're not gonna die, bitch.
What will you sing? Will you release us? Are we to fade away once more?
These needle-men. They stole our eggs from us. They sought to turn our children into beasts of war. Claws with no songs of their own.
Our elders are comfortable with silence. Children know only fear if no one sings to them. Fear has shattered their minds.
Makes sense. A baby left alone in a closet until he's sixteen won't be sane.
I understand. A child left alone in a closet until she is sixteen would not be sane.
Makes sense. A baby left alone in a closet until she's sixteen won't be sane.
No. Our minds are not as yours. We can only learn to sing in harmony. Without a mother, children are lost to silence.
You should not sing of them in grey and violet. We would have stilled them ourselves.
Our mandate is "whatever's necessary." If you don't have the guts to follow through, quit.
I don't understand. Why are your children killing people?
You could have calmed them if I hadn't set off the purge?
Rachni in the hot labs
I won't commit genocide.
I won't kill you.
Online. How can I help you?
I'm sorry, but I can't do that without proper code authorization.
Lady Benezia, an executive secretary of Binary Helix, is on the operations deck.
Yaroslev Tartakovsky, director of operations, is on the operations deck.
Logging you out, Commander.
Connecting. I have full access to the facility, and am at your disposal.
Verified. Code Omega execution in 120 seconds.
That is not the correct code. Please report to security for arrest and interrogation.
Who would have those codes?
Director of Operations Yaroslev Tartakovsky or any executive officer of Binary Helix.
I'm sorry. While functional, the system is not armed.
The purge controls are on the operations deck. A clearance key from one of the senior scientists is required to arm the system.
User alert! Neutron purge system active. Evacuation recommended.
User alert! The neutron purge system is armed. Activation will begin a two-minute countdown to facility sterilization.
Employees must reach minimum safe distance. Failure to evacuate may result in serious genetic damage.
Containment breach in Laboratory Pod Gamma. The neutron purge system is functional, but has not been armed.
There are no asari visible to my remaining internal sensors.
The neutron purge is a failsafe system installed within the isolation tube area. In the event of irretrievable containment loss, it is used to resolve the situation.
I'm sorry. The sensor network is too damaged to provide an accurate count.
"Guessing" is beyond my design parameters, Commander.
Activate the neutron purge.
Code input: 875-020-079. Code Omega local execution.
Uh, sic semper tyrana--[cough]
Who would have the code?
How do I arm it?
What's the status of the facility?
Is there an asari here?
I need information on the neutron purge.
How many of those things are in here?
Give me your best guess.
Are there any survivors in here?
We're moving on.
Most of the energy is released in the form of high-speed neutrons. This radiation is instantly lethal to any known form of life within 500 meters.
Important safety tip: don't hit big red buttons.
Okay, that's bad. Important safety tip: don't hit big red buttons.
Hmph. Just a pleasant afternoon in the sun for a krogan.
The purge is lethal to all known forms of--
Shut up. Last thing I need is some virtual wench questioning my fitness.
We would be wise to avoid touching any controls without reading the instructions.
It's always a good idea to RTFM, ma'am.
To what?
As if we needed more reasons to avoid touching things in here.
There is an asari I cannot identify standing next to you.
There are no others visible to my remaining internal sensors.
The purge is a neutron burst weapon. Two volumes of fissionable materials are brought together to form a critical mass.
What exactly does this thing do?
How you tolerate literal-minded VIs is beyond me.
Initiate the neutron purge.
The neutron purge.
Crew survivors
"Resolve" sounds final.
Estimate.
Situation report.
I have the code.
[Mumble something]
Where can I get it?
What do I do?
It's always a good idea to RTFM, Doctor.
That is advisable for all systems within this facility.
How many rachni are in here?
There are no other living crew members within the lab structure.
Are you here to secure the situation?
I am Yaroslav Tartakovsky, the operations director. I would stand and shake hand, but... Ehh.
No! Listen. The rachni are intelligent species. They achieve star travel. They are not animals.
No. They're more dangerous.
No. They're far more dangerous.
I am he. I direct the operations. I am not doing so much directing now.
I am certain you are having strong feelings. But what has happened here, it is our fault. You understand?
You must listen to me. If we do not contain our mistake, they will drop bombs from the battlestations. You understand?
Ehh. I am only following the orders.
Binary Helix found an egg. It was on a derelict ship, thousands of years drifting.
This was rachni ship. Inside they find many eggs in cryogenic suspension.
Yes. Very tough, to be so long frozen. That it survived the centuries -- this is miraculous.
I'm not sure I would qualify this as a miracle.
Binary Helix plan to clone rachni. Mass-produce them. Create an army.
But when they get here, they find this egg is not a common rachni. It is a queen.
Queens are born carrying the genetic code of their fathers. Eggs are carried away from the colony to hatch alone.
After she lays eggs, they move her to Rift Station. They are thinking that without her, they can raise the babies to be obedient.
I am thinking that without a queen, rachni do not develop properly. Her mind is shaping theirs. These rachni are uncontrollable.
Eh, you will forgive, but she is not a thing you leave out for viewing.
Ehh. This was exactly the wrong thing to do.
That's right, I'm a Council Spectre. Who're you?
You let these things out?
I don't understand anything yet. What were you doing here?
A thousand-year-old egg hatched?
Then all we need to do is bring her here.
